title: Sulo remote configuration
description: Remote kill switch and pacing for the Sulo extension and the Sulo Android app. Mirrors remoteConfigSchema (packages/core/src/remote/remote-config.ts), the Android app's keep-alive reader (packages/core/src/remote/keep-alive.ts) and its release reader (packages/core/src/remote/release.ts). This schema is stricter than the apps: unknown keys are rejected here, while the apps ignore them, and the Android app replaces any out-of-range field with its built-in default.

enabled.description: false stops every request from Sulo to SIKOLA in all installations. The extension shows `message` instead.

minIntervalMinutes.description: Minimum minutes between background syncs. Can only slow Sulo down: values below the built-in 180 are ignored.

message.description: Short Indonesian text shown to users while the extension is disabled. Plain text, never HTML.

mobile.description: Settings for the Sulo Android app only. The extension ignores this section.

backgroundKeepAlive.description: Background watching ('Pantau tugas baru'): periodic checks that keep the SIKOLA session alive while the user has the feature on. Read at most once a day, and when the app is opened after 6 hours; every phone follows a change within 6 to 24 hours.

enabled.description: false stops the checks on every phone at its next config read; the switch in Settings turns off and shows `message`. Default true.

dayIntervalMinutes.description: Minutes between checks from 06.00 to 22.59 device time. Default 20.

nightIntervalMinutes.description: Minutes between checks from 23.00 to 05.59 device time. Default 60.

radarEvery.description: Course structure checks (Radar) ride on every n-th daytime check, at most 4 courses each. Default 3.

message.description: Text under the switch while enabled is false. Plain text, never HTML. Both languages or none.

release.description: The latest Android release (Sulo 0.9 and later), read from this file the app already fetches: no extra request. A newer versionCode shows a calm card in the app with a Download button that opens `url` in the browser; Sulo never downloads or installs anything itself. Below minVersionCode the app shows one 'update required' screen and stops every request to SIKOLA until updated (security fixes only); user data stays. The app ignores the whole section when any field is invalid.

url.description: The APK asset of a GitHub release of Ikrar06. Anything else makes the app ignore this section.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the APK at `url` (shown to testers to compare; hidden from 1.0.0).

minVersionCode.description: Installed versions below this must update (security fixes only). 0 or absent: never required. Never above versionCode (the app ignores the section otherwise).

notes.description: One short line on what changed. Plain text, never HTML. Both languages or none.
